title: Retain magnetic stretching in the exact shear propagator
statement: For F=e_i s(x_j),i!=j,c=sprime,E=e_i tensor e_j and a=integral b, the actual ideal induction equation B_t=-bF.grad B+bB.grad F has propagator M_a=(I+a cE)T_a, T_a q=q(x-a s e_i). E²=0 and T commutes with c,so M_a^-1=M_-a exactly. The Piola form preserves divergence-free fields; mean zero is preserved by periodic integration. Fixed-order differentiation gives ||M_±a||_(Hm->Hm)<=C_m(1+|a|)^(m+1),each fixed integer m>=0. This is the magnetic pushforward,not the Euler perturbation propagator,scalar transport alone or a generic velocity-stability estimate.
